pieces.purpose: The sky: 32 bands of colour from the top of the view (dark) to the floor (light), 4 px each and 4 px wide; stretched to the view (the first band carries on above, the last below the floor).
The far layer of the jungle: hazy tree trunks and canopy masses. One tile, repeating sideways.
The middle layer: darker trunks with a few branch stubs. One tile, repeating sideways.
The near layer under the canopy: clumps of leaves hanging down. One tile, repeating sideways.
The near layer along the floor: ferns. One tile, repeating sideways.
The canopy strip the lianas hang from, in front of the world, with a leafy top edge for taller views. One tile, repeating sideways.

The top of the dark jungle floor, in front of the world: undergrowth along the floor line. One tile, repeating sideways; below it the floor is backdrop.floorFill, stretched down 1600 px below the band for taller views.
The floor's colour below the undergrowth, a small square stretched to fill the rest of the floor.
The tail of player 1, behind everything else.
A leg of player 1, 12 px down from its hip (the origin); it turns about the hip.
An arm of player 1, 21 px down from its shoulder (the origin); it turns about the shoulder.
The body of player 1; its origin is the centre of the monkey's hitbox. The limbs join it at the attachment points.
The head of player 1 (ears, face, muzzle), over the body.
The tail of player 2, behind everything else.
A leg of player 2, 12 px down from its hip (the origin); it turns about the hip.
An arm of player 2, 21 px down from its shoulder (the origin); it turns about the shoulder.
The body of player 2; its origin is the centre of the monkey's hitbox. The limbs join it at the attachment points.
The head of player 2 (ears, face, muzzle), over the body.
The tail of the shadow monkey, behind everything else.
A leg of the shadow monkey, 12 px down from its hip (the origin); it turns about the hip.
An arm of the shadow monkey, 21 px down from its shoulder (the origin); it turns about the shoulder.
The body of the shadow monkey; its origin is the centre of the monkey's hitbox. The limbs join it at the attachment points.
The head of the shadow monkey (ears, face, muzzle), over the body.
The monkey's eyes: open (frame 0), and crossed after a fall (frame 1).
The shadow monkey's eyes, see-through: open (frame 0), and crossed after a fall (frame 1).
The rope of the lianas: a straight strip 420 px along +x from the anchor (the origin), bent along the swinging rope.
A leaf on the lianas, 17 px from its base (the origin) along +x: light (frame 0) and dark (frame 1). Placed, turned and scaled per leaf.
The rope of player 2's own lianas in shared screen: a straight strip 420 px along +x from the anchor (the origin), bent along the swinging rope.
A leaf on player 2's own lianas in shared screen, 17 px from its base (the origin) along +x: light (frame 0) and dark (frame 1). Placed, turned and scaled per leaf.
The rope of the shadow monkey's lianas (see-through): a straight strip 420 px along +x from the anchor (the origin), bent along the swinging rope.
A leaf on the shadow monkey's lianas (see-through), 17 px from its base (the origin) along +x: light (frame 0) and dark (frame 1). Placed, turned and scaled per leaf.
The lit lower half of a liana, when the grip is about to slip off the end; bent like the rope.
A banana to take, about its centre (the origin): curved, with a ridge, a stem and a dark tip. It bobs and rocks.
A four-pointed glint on a banana (or a heart), about its centre; it fades in and out.
A heart to take (a banana turned into a life), 17 px across about its centre.
A heart in the HUD, 11 px across about its centre: a life left (frame 0), a life lost (frame 1, an outline).
The banana by each player's banana count in the HUD (11 px), about its centre.
The banana by the bananas taken on the results (13 px), about its centre.
A panel: a see-through dark rounded rectangle (radius 18) with a faint edge, from its top left (the origin), 64 px square; 9-sliced to each panel's size.
The arrow at the top edge pointing up at a monkey above the view; its tip at the origin.
The mute button: a speaker, from its top left (the origin).
The speaker's sound waves, while the sound is on (in the speaker's coordinates).
The cross by the speaker, while muted (in its coordinates).
The full-screen button, from its top left (the origin): corner brackets pointing out to enter full screen (frame 0), pulled in to leave it (frame 1).
The vine a high obstacle hangs from, from the canopy down to it. A straight strip 20 px along +x from the origin, 3 px across; bent along the curve.
A round end or joint of support.vine: a disc 3 px across about the origin.
The stem a low thorn bush or rock stands on, from its top (the origin) 100 px down; stretched to reach below the floor.
The trunk beside a low beehive, from its top (the origin) 480 px down; shrunk to reach below the floor.
The branch: a limb from a cut stub, with a leaf tuft near the tip. Its origin is the hitbox centre.
A dark line in the bark, 14 px along +x; four per branch, placed, turned and stretched.
The trunk a low branch stands on, from its top (the origin) 100 px down; stretched to reach below the floor.
A black panther lying on the branch, head up: the body and head. It breathes (scaled up and down).
The inside of the ear that flicks, about its own centre (folded by scaling).
The eyes: open (frame 0) and shut (frame 1).
The tail hanging off the end of the branch, in 16 frames from its tip swung 6 px one way to as far the other.
A small red bird perched on the branch: the body, its feet at the origin.
The red perched bird's tail, from its root (the origin); it flicks about the root.
The red perched bird's head about its centre (the origin); it dips to peck.
A small blue bird perched on the branch: the body, its feet at the origin.
The blue perched bird's tail, from its root (the origin); it flicks about the root.
The blue perched bird's head about its centre (the origin); it dips to peck.
A small purple bird perched on the branch: the body, its feet at the origin.
The purple perched bird's tail, from its root (the origin); it flicks about the root.
The purple perched bird's head about its centre (the origin); it dips to peck.
The tail of a snake coiled round the branch, tapering from its root (the origin) past the last coil: round the trunk (frame 0) or the limb (frame 1).

The front of a coil, slanting across the wood from its top (the origin): round the trunk (frame 0, 26 px thick), or round the limb (frame 1, for a limb 20 px thick, stretched across to the limb's thickness).
A dark scale mark on a coil, 2 px in radius about the origin; scaled.
The neck of the coiled snake, rising from the last coil to the head. A straight strip 20 px along +x from the origin, 7 px across; bent along the curve.
A round end or joint of perchedSnake.neck: a disc 7 px across about the origin.
The coiled snake's head, about the end of its neck (the origin), facing +x; it sways and turns.
Its tongue, flicking now and then (in the head's coordinates).
A grey monkey hanging under the branch: the arms, its hands at the origin (it swings about them).
The hanging monkey's body and head (in the hands' coordinates).
A leg of the hanging monkey, from its hip, kicking. A straight segment 20 px along +x from the origin, 4.2 px across; stretched to each length and turned.
A round end or joint of hangingMonkey.leg: a disc 4.2 px across about the origin.
The hanging monkey's tail curling out and up, in 13 frames from the least curled to the most (in the hands' coordinates).
Its eyes: open (frame 0) and shut (frame 1).
A purple bat hanging upside down under the branch, wrapped in its wings; its feet at the origin (it sways about them).
The purple hanging bat's eyes: shut (frame 0) and open (frame 1).
The purple hanging bat's ear that twitches, in 9 frames from still to the full twitch.
A brown bat hanging upside down under the branch, wrapped in its wings; its feet at the origin (it sways about them).
The brown hanging bat's eyes: shut (frame 0) and open (frame 1).
The brown hanging bat's ear that twitches, in 9 frames from still to the full twitch.
A grey bat hanging upside down under the branch, wrapped in its wings; its feet at the origin (it sways about them).
The grey hanging bat's eyes: shut (frame 0) and open (frame 1).
The grey hanging bat's ear that twitches, in 9 frames from still to the full twitch.
A black bat hanging upside down under the branch, wrapped in its wings; its feet at the origin (it sways about them).
The black hanging bat's eyes: shut (frame 0) and open (frame 1).
The black hanging bat's ear that twitches, in 9 frames from still to the full twitch.
An owl perched on the branch: the body, its feet at the origin; it puffs as it breathes.
The owl's head with its ear tufts, about its centre (the origin); it tilts as it turns.
The pale face round the eyes (in the head's coordinates); it slides as the head turns.
The beak (in the face's coordinates).
An eye, about its centre.
A pupil, about the eye's centre; it leads the turn.
An eye shut, about its centre.
A nest on the branch: the back of the bowl and its dark inside, its foot at the origin.
The front wall of the nest, over its contents (in the nest's coordinates).
The rim of the nest, over the front wall and its twigs.
A dark twig woven across the front of the nest. A straight segment 20 px along +x from the origin, 1.2 px across; stretched to each length and turned.
A round end or joint of nest.twig: a disc 1.2 px across about the origin.
A light twig woven across the front of the nest. A straight segment 20 px along +x from the origin, 1.2 px across; stretched to each length and turned.
A round end or joint of nest.lightTwig: a disc 1.2 px across about the origin.
A twig stuck out of the rim. A straight segment 20 px along +x from the origin, 1.4 px across; stretched to each length and turned.
A round end or joint of nest.rimTwig: a disc 1.4 px across about the origin.
An egg in the nest, about its centre (placed at 0, -11); it rocks now and then.
The cracked shell a chick hatched from, about its centre.
The chick, about its centre; it bobs and tilts.
The chick's beak, in 9 frames from shut to wide open (in the chick's coordinates).
The top of the shell, tipped on the rim.
A dry leaf curled in the bottom of an empty nest (in the nest's coordinates).
A flower's stem, 20 px up from its foot (the origin), curving a little; stretched to each flower's height.
A leaf on a stem, 7 px from its base (the origin) along +x: green (frame 0) and dark (frame 1). Placed, turned and scaled per leaf.
A petal, 4 px in radius about its centre: white, tinted with the flower's colour, and scaled.
A flower's heart, 4 px in radius about its centre: white, tinted, and scaled.
The frond a bunch of coconuts hangs from, under the branch; the stems spring from the origin.
The stem from the frond to a nut. A straight segment 20 px along +x from the origin, 1.8 px across; stretched to each length and turned.
A round end or joint of coconut.stem: a disc 1.8 px across about the origin.
A coconut 7 px in radius, its top at the origin: brown, a highlight and three dark eyes; scaled to each nut.
A hair on a nut's outline, at its right (about the nut's centre, which is the origin); turned round the nut.
The thorn bush: three dark circles with a highlight each. Its origin is the hitbox centre.
A thorn, its base at the origin, pointing along +x; placed round the outline and turned.
The mound a low thorn bush grows from (in the bush's coordinates).
The rock, in 24 outlines (one frame each, picked by gap): grey, with a lit and a shaded facet. Its origin is the hitbox centre.
The vine's loop round a hanging rock (in the rock's coordinates).
The ledge a low rock sits on (in the rock's coordinates).
The beehive: a teardrop in gold paper bands with a dark entrance at the bottom. Its origin is the hitbox centre.
The arm over a low beehive from the trunk beside it, and the rope the nest hangs on (in the hive's coordinates).
A bee: a round yellow body with a dark stripe, about the origin.
A bee's wing at its widest (2.6 px half height), about its centre; squeezed as it beats.
The limestone temple down to the top of its base: the shrine, the three tiers and the stairs on them, a stepped fret on the shrine. Its origin is the top centre of the shrine (the hitbox's).
The first 92 px of the limestone temple's base, from its lit top edge (at y 202): courses of blocks and a row of panels.
The limestone temple's base below that: 92 px, from its top (the origin's y), that repeat down to the floor.
The limestone temple's stairs below the tiers, with their low walls: 8 steps (96 px, from the top of a step at the origin's y) that repeat down to the floor.
The sandstone temple down to the top of its base: the shrine, the three tiers and the stairs on them, a roof comb over the shrine. Its origin is the top centre of the shrine (the hitbox's).
The first 92 px of the sandstone temple's base, from its lit top edge (at y 202): courses of blocks and a row of panels.
The sandstone temple's base below that: 92 px, from its top (the origin's y), that repeat down to the floor.
The sandstone temple's stairs below the tiers, with their low walls: 8 steps (96 px, from the top of a step at the origin's y) that repeat down to the floor.
The mossy temple down to the top of its base: the shrine, the three tiers and the stairs on them, serpent heads on the stairs and moss. Its origin is the top centre of the shrine (the hitbox's).
The first 92 px of the mossy temple's base, from its lit top edge (at y 202): courses of blocks and a row of panels.
The mossy temple's base below that: 92 px, from its top (the origin's y), that repeat down to the floor.
The mossy temple's stairs below the tiers, with their low walls: 8 steps (96 px, from the top of a step at the origin's y) that repeat down to the floor.
The basalt temple down to the top of its base: the shrine, the three tiers and the stairs on them, gold inlay and two braziers. Its origin is the top centre of the shrine (the hitbox's).
The first 92 px of the basalt temple's base, from its lit top edge (at y 202): courses of blocks and a row of panels.
The basalt temple's base below that: 92 px, from its top (the origin's y), that repeat down to the floor.
The basalt temple's stairs below the tiers, with their low walls: 8 steps (96 px, from the top of a step at the origin's y) that repeat down to the floor.

A leaf on a temple (the fringe of ferns at its foot, and on the corners of the tiers), 86 px from its base (the origin) along +x, in the greens FRINGE_DEEP, BUSH, FRINGE, BUSH_LIGHT, LEAF_DARK, LEAF, MOSS, MOSS_LIGHT (one frame each); placed, turned and scaled per leaf.
A patch of moss on a tier, 22 by 4.5 px (half) about its centre: dark (frame 0) and light (frame 1); stretched sideways.
A vine hanging from a patch of moss. A straight strip 20 px along +x from the origin, 2 px across; bent along the curve.

The green haze over the foot of the temple: the top half of nested soft ellipses, about their centre (the origin, 30 px below the temple's floor), down to 40 px above it, where the jungle floor covers it.
A brazier's flame (in the temple's coordinates, its brazier at x 0), in 7 × 7 frames: swayed from 3 px left to 3 px right, each from the lowest to the highest.
A layer of the warm light round a brazier in the dark stages: a disc about its centre, at its largest. The glow is sixteen of them, each scaled and faded, added to what is behind it.
The spider: abdomen, head, a red mark and four eyes. Its origin is the hitbox centre.
A spider's leg, from the body out to the knee or from the knee down to the foot. A straight segment 20 px along +x from the origin, 2.5 px across; stretched to each length and turned.
A round end or joint of spider.leg: a disc 2.5 px across about the origin.
The thread from the canopy down to the spider. A straight segment 20 px along +x from the origin, 1.5 px across; stretched to each length and turned.
The stalk a snake climbs, from the floor up to the top of its climb. A straight strip 20 px along +x from the origin, 7 px across; bent along the curve.
A round end or joint of snake.stalk: a disc 7 px across about the origin.
A leaf on the stalk, from its base on the stalk (the origin): pointing up and right (frame 0) and up and left (frame 1).
The climbing snake's coils round the stalk. Its origin is the hitbox centre.
Its neck and head, pointing up (in the coil's coordinates); flipped to point down.
The red bird, facing +x: tail, body, belly, head, beak and eye. Its origin is the hitbox centre.
The red bird's wing (in the body's coordinates), in 33 frames from all the way down to all the way up.
The blue bird, facing +x: tail, body, belly, crest, head, beak and eye. Its origin is the hitbox centre.
The blue bird's wing (in the body's coordinates), in 33 frames from all the way down to all the way up.
The purple bird, facing +x: tail, body, belly, crest, head, beak and eye. Its origin is the hitbox centre.
The purple bird's wing (in the body's coordinates), in 33 frames from all the way down to all the way up.
A purple bat flying, facing +x: body, ears, eye and feet. Its origin is the hitbox centre.
The purple bat's wing (in the body's coordinates, behind it), in 41 frames from all the way down to all the way up.
A brown bat flying, facing +x: body, ears, eye and feet. Its origin is the hitbox centre.
The brown bat's wing (in the body's coordinates, behind it), in 41 frames from all the way down to all the way up.
A grey bat flying, facing +x: body, ears, eye and feet. Its origin is the hitbox centre.
The grey bat's wing (in the body's coordinates, behind it), in 41 frames from all the way down to all the way up.
A black bat flying, facing +x: body, ears, eye and feet. Its origin is the hitbox centre.
The black bat's wing (in the body's coordinates, behind it), in 41 frames from all the way down to all the way up.
Cartoon stone title with the concept sun/spiral O.
